summary: Frontend-only test on Expo web preview (390x844) of the NEW two-deck overlapping crossfade in /app/frontend/app/contexts/AudioPlayerContext.tsx + regression pass. Audio was verified at the HTMLMediaElement level via a volume/play probe that was re-installed after every reload. ALL 15 requested flows PASS. REGRESSION 1 (basic playback): War Pigs plays with exactly 1 un-paused element at vol 1 (t 3.2 -> 5.7 advancing); play/pause -> 0 active, resume -> 1 active vol 1 continuing from 7.2s. REGRESSION 2 (Next/Prev + 5 rapid Next): title and audible file switch together, always exactly 1 active at vol 1, Prev disabled on track 1. REGRESSION 3 (slider seek): clicking the mini-player slider middle jumps t=2.3 -> 101.2 with 1 active at vol 1. REGRESSION 4 (Search, Favorites, Library): War Pigs plays from Search (1 active vol 1); favoriting via mini-player heart now shows War Pigs in the Favorites tab and it plays from there (pre-existing favorites key mismatch bug from iteration_9 appears to be fixed). REGRESSION 5 (reload resume): played War Pigs ~16s, reloaded -> 0 active (paused as expected), Play -> same title, position resumed at ~19s, Next works. REGRESSION 6: mini-player time label and progress bar updated smoothly during playback, UI responsive while interacting. CROSSFADE A (automatic overlap after seekNearEnd(6)): for ~4s TWO elements are un-paused simultaneously, outgoing drops 1.00 -> 0.98 -> 0.86 -> 0.66 -> 0.40 while incoming rises 0.00 -> 0.28 -> 0.56 -> 0.79 -> 0.94 -> 1.00, equal-power sqrt(v_out^2+v_in^2) stays between 1.000 and 1.032 (no dip to silence), mini-player title switches to track 2 at start of overlap, afterwards exactly 1 element active at vol 1 on track 2. CROSSFADE B (3 consecutive overlaps): max 2 un-paused simultaneously each time, titles follow folder order War Pigs -> Dust On The Bottle -> Fast Car -> I Just Wanna Dance With You. CROSSFADE C (pause mid-overlap): both volumes >0.2 at pause -> 0 active, Play -> exactly ONE active = INCOMING track at vol 1 (I Swear t=2.3, old track stays paused). CROSSFADE D (Next mid-overlap): hard cut to track AFTER the incoming one (I Swear x Chick Fried overlap, Next -> Islands In The Stream, 1 active vol 1); Prev mid-overlap -> 1 active vol 1 with matching title. CROSSFADE E (row tap mid-overlap): tapped War Pigs during an overlap, War Pigs plays alone at vol 1 from t=2.4s. CROSSFADE F (shuffle while playing): current track keeps playing with no restart (t 101.2 -> 102.8), crossfade after shuffle produces a different next track (You Proof) matching the mini-player title. CROSSFADE G (crossfade OFF): seekNearEnd(6) + 8.8s sampling -> max concurrent active = 1, min max-volume across all samples = 1.00 (no overlap, next track at full volume); switching back ON and reloading twice preserved the stored setting (confirmed by observed behavior; the Switch did not expose aria-checked, see note below). CROSSFADE H (last track of folder, track 18 You Proof): seekNearEnd(6) -> no second element, max_active stays 1, playback stops at the end (0 active), pressing Play restarts the last track. NO console errors or red error screens; only a benign `useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation` warning. Combined equal-power stays within 1.000-1.032 and never dips below 1.0, confirming the fix for the Galaxy S25 Ultra 'goes silent' bug on web.

issues: The React-Native Web Switch does not expose aria-checked (or role=switch with a boolean state) to accessibility; tests had to infer state from audio behaviour. Consider adding accessibilityState={{checked: crossfadeEnabled}} or a testID so the state is programmatically readable.

action_items: LOW: Add accessibilityState={{checked: crossfadeEnabled}} and/or testID="crossfade-switch" to the Crossfade Switch in app/(tabs)/profile.tsx so automated tests can read its state (does not affect functionality - the setting works and persists correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: AudioPlayerContext.tsx is 1015 lines, above the 700-line guideline; consider extracting the crossfade engine (cueIdleDeck / startCrossfade / commitCrossfade / settleCrossfade / onStatus / onTrackChanged) into a dedicated hook or module for maintainability.
All fades are driven exclusively by native playlistStatusUpdate events (no setInterval / setTimeout), which is the whole point of the rewrite - good.
Equal-power curves (sin / cos) in utils/crossfadeSettings.ts produce a combined power of 1.00-1.03 across the measured samples - correct, no silence dip.
Manual tap / Next / Previous / seek / shuffle all call settleCrossfade() before doing anything else, so overlapping tracks are torn down cleanly - verified end-to-end.
Lock-screen controls, Android screen-off behaviour and Bluetooth metadata cannot be tested in the Expo web preview - must be checked on a device build.
seed_data_creation: Per-session browser storage only: favorites (via mini-player heart for War Pigs), last_playback_state (resume test). Nothing persisted beyond the ephemeral browser context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio probe install snippet is in the review request. It MUST be re-installed after every reload (reload wipes the prototype patch). Reliable testIDs now exist: mini-player-previous, mini-player-play-pause, mini-player-next, collection-shuffle. The Crossfade Switch has no testID and no aria-checked; verify its state by observing audio behaviour (max_active, max volume across samples) or by reading localStorage (but AsyncStorage on web stores under a prefixed key so localStorage.getItem('crossfade_enabled') returns null). Use window.__audioProbe.seekNearEnd(6) to force a crossfade within ~6s rather than waiting for tracks to end. The browser keeps PAUSED preloaded elements for upcoming tracks - always judge via activeSnap() (un-paused only). Track 18 of November 2026 Releases is 'You Proof (Morgan Wallen x Jonas Blue)'.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bug found in this iteration. The two-deck overlapping crossfade works correctly on web: equal power stays near 1.0, no silence dip, title/highlight switch at start of overlap, manual interactions tear down the overlap cleanly, crossfade OFF produces a single-player flow. The reported Android lock-screen / screen-off behaviour cannot be verified on web and requires a native device build.
